[Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:35:32 GMT | freshness: unknown] Taiwan Stocks Rebound 956 Points, but Foreign Investors Still Pull NT$49.18 Billion; Taiwan Glass Hit with 81,000-Share Selloff as Active ETFs Become the Buying Focus - BigGo Finance
Taiwan's stock market staged a strong rebound on the 26th, with the weighted index surging 956.38 points to close at 39,151.81, while turnover expanded to NT$817.467 billion (approximately $24.8 billion). Taiwan Glass topped the foreign sell list with 81,441 shares sold, followed by three financial stocks—SinoPac Financial, Mega Financial Holding, and First Financial Holding—while Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, United Microelectronics, and the Yuanta Taiwan Top 50 ETF also saw reductions. On the buy side, active ETFs swept the top five spots, led by Active Fuh Hwa Future 50 with 261,000 shares, while Innolux was the most-bought individual stock at 24,000 shares. Yet the strong rebound in the spot market did not reverse foreign investors' direction—foreign and mainland Chinese investors remained net sellers of NT$49.181 billion (approximately $1.5 billion) on the day, marking a ninth consecutive session on the selling side and bringing cumulative net selling to NT$470.843 billion (approximately $14.3 billion).
